title: RISCBoy is an open-source portable games console, designed from scratch
summary: RISCBoy is an open-source portable handheld gaming console built from scratch using RISC-V architecture, featuring custom hardware design and embedded firmware development.
problem_solved: Provides an open-source, fully customizable handheld gaming console alternative to commercial devices
why_valuable: Enables hobbyists and developers to learn embedded systems, hardware design, and RISC-V architecture through a complete, functional project
